title: Validate Package.json Executor
description: Validates that package.json dependencies match project.json build dependencies, and that each dependency sits in the correct section (dependencies vs devDependencies)

testOnlyDepMode.description: What to do when a package imported ONLY by test/dev files is listed in "dependencies" (so `pnpm deploy --prod` ships it to production). 'error' fails the build (default), 'warn' reports without failing (migration path for existing repos), 'off' skips the check.
